jobs.title: Mixtiles Engineering
jobs.description: [ We help people create homes they love ] Join The Team 81.3M Processed photos per year 2.1B Events per year 54 Million people see us on Facebook each month 2.4M Revenue per employee 3.1M Users per month Rated 4.9 on the App Store Based on 10,000+ Reviews 30 Millions Square meters covered with tiles Our Story Mixtiles started in 2016 by two best friends, David and Eytan, who wanted to make wall decoration simple. Fast forward to today, together with our team of 50 super-talented designers, engineers, marketing, and operations experts, we’ve become the fastest growing company to have ever existed in our industry. Our vision forward is to deepen our existing reach, and to expand into new product categories, turning our wild crazy dreams into reality. That’s more or less it. But if you’re still curious, keep scrolling. Our growing team Ofek Software Engineer Michael Head of Engineering Tal Team Lead Adiel Head of Engineering Ori Head of Ops (Around) Dori Software Engineer Dror Software Engineer Ido Head of Engineering Adam Head of Design Yuval Product Manager Nimrod iOS Engineer Din QA Engineer Evyatar Product Designer Inbal Head of Design Jonathan Software Engineer Avishai Software Engineer Chen Software Engineer Our stack Express JS React Node JS Redis Cloudinary Sentry AWS Mongo Heroku Loggly Amplitude BigQuery Looker Optimizely Buddybuild Github Swift Fivetran Stitch Data CircleCI Cloudflare Figma Why we need tech? Mixtiles needs tech for the same reason Amazon needs tech. To continue scaling our products and creating more beautiful homes at a super-fast pace, we use the software in every part of our business to continually optimize it - digital product, manufacturing, marketing, and customer service. This has been the key to our success ever since the company's founding. Scale Mixtiles is growing at a fast pace, and just keeping everything operational is a challenge 3B+ Events Per Year Processing 81.3M photos per year 30 Millions square meters covered with tiles Over 3M happy customers 300 Millions people see us on Facebook each month Manufacturing & Shipping Automation Our software controls manufacturing and shipping in all our factories, for exceptional cost efficiency and reliable fulfillment of our customer's orders 7 Factories on 3 continents, delivering to tens of thousands of customers per month Big Data & Machine learning At every moment, millions of events are collected At every moment we have a few tens of A/B test running We are leveraging more than 1B yearly events, and make more than 100K yearly queries to learn about our users and drive growth Augmented Reality We think the future of home design is Augmented Reality, we're developing cutting edge technology for designing homes in a magical way. Internet of Things We're working on mass market IoT products, we can't share much more here but we'd love to talk about it in person. What are we working on? Mixtiles Photos from your phone to your wall Mixtiles Art The best art marketplace in the world easyplant Smart plants that live forever Working at Mixtiles We’re looking for talented people, who share our passion for building great products that millions of people bring inside their homes. Join The Team

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer TEL AVIV Apply
jobs.description: Press Alt+1 for screen-reader mode, Alt+0 to cancel Accessibility Screen-Reader Guide, Feedback, and Issue Reporting | New window All Positions > Engineering > Senior Full Stack Engineer Senior Full Stack Engineer Tel-Aviv | Engineering | Full-time We help millions of people create homes they love In the beginning, in 2016, we were just two best friends working on a simple idea: how to make it super easy to turn your favorite smartphone photos into awesome wall art. Today, we have multiple product lines with millions of customers, including Mixtiles, easyplant and Oasis. We're also shipping new products every year. We love what we do, and we love people who love what they do. If you're that kind of person, read on. Small team = a lot of impact We’re ~100 people, with wildly diverse skill sets, serving millions of customers. Each of us drives a lot of impact. Your work will matter Products people love Working on products you & your family personally use creates a feeling of connection, fun, and spreads good karma Our secret formula = make it easy to use It’s how we re-invented the picture frame, and then the houseplant. It’s how we got to millions of customers. It’s pure design, and people love it Solve hard, real world problems Every day, we handle extreme challenges in user experience, manufacturing and scale for which we use tech like AI, AR & robotics A real business, built to last We believe great products have great unit economics. That’s why Mixtiles is a high growth company that’s also profitable How do R&D teams look like in Mixtiles? Mixtiles R&D teams are running as separate squads, each executing on their own goals and focusing on their products. We do sprints, working to create a fast impact. Our squads are small (3-5 people) and work closely with product managers and designers to bring changes to life. We are as Full Stack as we can, not afraid to touch and change what’s needed to get the needle moving. Frontend, Backend, Devops, Quality and more. We do it all and we own what we do. We work together. We use each other to be better and move faster. Why should I work at Mixtiles? You will build new things and improve on products that reach millions of customers. You will learn how to “start up” - Data based decision making. Learn from company’s experience launching multiple products. You will work with other senior engineers and keep growing together with them. You will use technology to create great experiences for customers. What's life at Mixtiles like? We built the company the way we build products. We aim to have the best experience for our employees. We created a great working environment for employees. We care deeply about each other and what we do. We make data-based decisions on how our culture should look, gathering as much feedback as possible from employees and striving to build the best experience for all. We ensure whoever joins us shares our vision and our way of operating. Who are you? You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer Exceptional track record of excellence (e.g., ex-8200 / academic distinctions / upwards career trajectory) You care about creating the best customer experience You share our view of the world as outlined above If you worked in a startup or a B2C company, that’s a great bonus Apply Here

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Oasis TEL AVIV Apply
jobs.description: All Positions > Engineering > Engineering Manager, Oasis Engineering Manager, Oasis Tel-Aviv | Engineering | Full-time We help millions of people create homes they love In the beginning, in 2016, we were just two best friends working on a simple idea: how to make it super easy to turn your favorite smartphone photos into awesome wall art. Today, we have multiple product lines with millions of customers, including Mixtiles, easyplant and Oasis. We're also shipping new products every year. We love what we do, and we love people who love what they do. If you're that kind of person, read on. Small team = a lot of impact We’re ~100 people, with wildly diverse skill sets, serving millions of customers. Each of us drives a lot of impact. Your work will matter Products people love Working on products you & your family personally use creates a feeling of connection, fun, and spreads good karma Our secret formula = make it easy to use It’s how we re-invented the picture frame, and then the houseplant. It’s how we got to millions of customers. It’s pure design, and people love it Solve hard, real world problems Every day, we handle extreme challenges in user experience, manufacturing and scale for which we use tech like AI, AR & robotics A real business, built to last We believe great products have great unit economics. That’s why Mixtiles is a high growth company that’s also profitable The Company Mixtiles is a $300M profitable consumer brand reinventing how homes feel. We build products people didn't know they needed - and now can't imagine living without. Wall photos. Self-watering plants. Smart lighting. Oasis is our newest business - and one of our fastest-growing. In just over a year, it has grown into a ~$40M business, proving that people are ready for a better lighting experience. Now we're building what comes next. The Role Oasis has product-market fit. Now we're looking for the engineering leader who can help take it to millions of homes. You'll lead a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for the entire product - from firmware and hardware to cloud, mobile, and software. Your role is to build an engineering organization that moves fast, sets a high technical bar, and delivers a product that feels simple, magical, and reliable. You'll work closely with the GM and the leadership team to shape both the product and the technology behind it. You'll help decide what we build, how we build it, and how we scale it. This is an opportunity to lead engineering at the intersection of hardware, software, AI, and consumer experience. What You'll Do Lead and grow a high-performing multidisciplinary engineering team Own the technical direction of Oasis as it scales from a successful product to a global category leader Bring together firmware, hardware, cloud, mobile, and software into one seamless customer experience Build a culture of speed, ownership, technical excellence, and collaboration Partner closely with Product, Design, and Operations to shape both the roadmap and execution Make thoughtful technical decisions that balance customer experience, scalability, quality, and long-term maintainability Who You Are You've led engineering teams building complex consumer products You're comfortable leading across multiple engineering disciplines—not just software You know how to build strong teams while staying close enough to the technology to make the right decisions You combine technical depth with excellent product judgment You care deeply about customer experience and understand that great technology should feel invisible You're energized by taking a product from strong product-market fit to global scale Bonus Points Experience with IoT or connected consumer devices Background in consumer (B2C) products or startups Experience leading products that combine hardware and software Entrepreneurial experience or having helped scale an early-stage business Apply Here
